environment.browser: Chromium desktop, packaged Java Terminal backend, isolated PCL2 fixture
environment.minecraft: Fabric 1.21.1 and Forge 1.20.1 dedicated GameTest/runtime fixtures
environment.userData: No real launcher profile, account, world, or user instance is touched

interactions.zhCN: 总览；启动器与实例；安装管理；游戏启动；AI 伙伴；自动检查；运行服务；模型服务；搜索与隐私；外部 AI 控制器；技能；兼容层；诊断；日志与支持；设置与安全
interactions.enUS: Overview; Launchers & instances; Installation; Game launch; AI companions; Automated checks; Runtime service; Model service; Search & privacy; External AI controller; Skills; Compatibility; Diagnostics; Logs & support; Settings & security
interactions.expectedState: Selected route becomes active and its page renders

interactions.zhCN: 界面语言 / 简体中文
interactions.expectedState: Visible copy and ARIA labels switch without reload; selection persists
html data-theme changes and persists
Every page and write plan binds to the selected instance ID
Backend and instance snapshot refresh without losing route or locale
Isolated PCL2 fixture and exact Fabric metadata are rediscovered
Dynamic launcher, installation, Runtime and protocol evidence refresh
Only the selected repair executes; diagnostics re-run
Managed Mod is installed, manifest/hash verifies, UI and /api/instances show installed
New rollback point is durable and managed hashes verify
Existing exact files verify without fabricated change; drift is restored transactionally

interactions.control: Rollback-point selector and review rollback plan
interactions.zhCN: 可用回滚点 / 审阅回滚计划
interactions.enUS: Available rollback point / Review rollback plan
interactions.backend: GET /api/install/rollbacks; POST plan action=rollback and execute
interactions.expectedState: Selected transaction snapshot is restored; browser proves the pre-install point removes installed state, then reinstall recovers
Managed Mod is removed; Runtime is stopped; profile data remains configured; worlds and unrelated Mods remain

interactions.zhCN: 卸载并删除 MCAC 数据
interactions.expectedState: Only manifest-owned files and current MCAC profile data are removed; /api/runtime/status reports configured=false
PID and both loopback listeners exist; authenticated health identity matches
PID is not alive and both assigned ports are closed
Old process stops, new process is healthy, identity and profile remain exact
Token is never returned to UI; Runtime restarts and authenticated identity still matches
Runtime is healthy and session truthfully remains SAFE_IDLE without a connected game
Automated preflight, install and Runtime stages complete; external launcher owns login and account launch
interactions.exclusionReason: PCL2/HMCL account login and the final user-selected game launch require a real launcher account; preflight, planning, timeout and cancellation are automated
